summary.text: Larry Scott is a Republican who has served in the New Mexico Senate since 2025, representing District 42 in Chaves, Eddy and Lea counties.
The legislature's member page lists Scott as a representative from 2015 to 2024, and as ranking member of the Senate Health and Public Affairs Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists Scott's occupation as engineer and a district office in Hobbs.

Scott also sits on the Senate Conservation Committee and, between sessions, on the Legislative Health and Human Services Committee, the Water and Natural Resources Committee and the Behavioral Health Subcommittee.
